title.en: Epic Efficiency: Nissan Qashqai e-POWER Smashes World Record with Astounding 1,230-Mile Single-Tank Range
title.de: Epische Effizienz: Nissan Qashqai e-POWER bricht Weltrekord mit erstaunlicher 1.979 km Reichweite mit einer Tankfüllung
title.es: Eficiencia Épica: Nissan Qashqai e-POWER Rompe Récord Mundial con una Asombrosa Autonomía de 1.979 km con un Solo Tanque
title.tr: Destansı Verimlilik: Nissan Qashqai e-POWER Tek Depoyla İnanılmaz 1.979 Kilometre Menzil ile Dünya Rekoru Kırdı
title.fr: Efficacité Épique : Le Nissan Qashqai e-POWER Bat un Record du Monde avec une Autonomie Étonnante de 1 979 km avec un Seul Plein

summary.en: The Nissan Qashqai e-POWER has rewritten the rules of hybrid efficiency, achieving an incredible 1,230 miles (1,979 km) on a mere 14.5-gallon (55-liter) tank in Colombia. This groundbreaking feat highlights the revolutionary capabilities of Nissan's third-generation series-hybrid system, delivering EV-like driving dynamics with unparalleled fuel economy, proving that long-distance travel can be both sustainable and effortless.
summary.de: Der Nissan Qashqai e-POWER hat die Regeln der Hybrid-Effizienz neu geschrieben und in Kolumbien unglaubliche 1.979 km mit nur einem 55-Liter-Tank erreicht. Diese bahnbrechende Leistung unterstreicht die revolutionären Fähigkeiten von Nissans Hybrid-System der dritten Generation, das ein EV-ähnliches Fahrerlebnis mit unübertroffener Kraftstoffeffizienz bietet und beweist, dass Langstreckenfahrten sowohl nachhaltig als auch mühelos sein können.
summary.es: El Nissan Qashqai e-POWER ha reescrito las reglas de la eficiencia híbrida, logrando un increíble recorrido de 1.979 km con un tanque de solo 55 litros en Colombia. Esta hazaña pionera destaca las capacidades revolucionarias del sistema híbrido en serie de tercera generación de Nissan, ofreciendo una dinámica de conducción similar a la de un VE con una economía de combustible inigualable, demostrando que los viajes de larga distancia pueden ser sostenibles y sin esfuerzo.
summary.tr: Nissan Qashqai e-POWER, Kolombiya'da sadece 55 litrelik bir depo ile inanılmaz 1.979 km yol kat ederek hibrit verimlilik kurallarını yeniden yazdı. Bu çığır açan başarı, Nissan'ın üçüncü nesil seri hibrit sisteminin devrim niteliğindeki yeteneklerini vurguluyor; eşsiz yakıt ekonomisiyle EV benzeri sürüş dinamikleri sunarak uzun mesafe seyahatlerin hem sürdürülebilir hem de zahmetsiz olabileceğini kanıtlıyor.
summary.fr: Le Nissan Qashqai e-POWER a redéfini les règles de l'efficacité hybride, réalisant l'incroyable exploit de parcourir 1 979 km avec un réservoir de seulement 55 litres en Colombie. Cette prouesse révolutionnaire met en lumière les capacités du système hybride série de troisième génération de Nissan, offrant une dynamique de conduite similaire à celle d'un VE avec une économie de carburant inégalée, prouvant que les longs trajets peuvent être à la fois durables et sans effort.

content.en:
In a world increasingly focused on sustainable mobility without compromising on practicality, the Nissan Qashqai e-POWER has just delivered a statement of intent that reverberates across the automotive landscape. This isn't just about numbers on a spec sheet; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible for a family SUV. Driving an astounding 1,230 miles (1,979 km) on a single 14.5-gallon (55-liter) tank of fuel through the diverse and often challenging terrains of Colombia, the Qashqai e-POWER has officially etched its name into the record books. This remarkable feat isn't merely a testament to clever engineering; it's a profound demonstration of real-world efficiency that could redefine consumer expectations for hybrid vehicles.

The secret to this extraordinary endurance lies deep within Nissan's innovative e-POWER system. Unlike conventional hybrids, the e-POWER architecture is a series-hybrid setup where the gasoline engine acts purely as a generator. Its sole purpose is to produce electricity, which then powers an electric motor that, in turn, drives the wheels directly. This means the Qashqai e-POWER always feels like an EV to drive, offering instant torque, smooth acceleration, and a remarkably quiet cabin, all without the need for external charging. The third-generation system, at the heart of this record-breaker, incorporates Nissan's sophisticated 1.5-liter variable compression turbo engine, optimized to run at its most efficient RPMs to generate electricity, further enhancing both power delivery and fuel economy.

To put 1,230 miles into perspective, imagine driving from London to Rome, or cruising from New York City to Miami, all without stopping for fuel. This isn't just a laboratory test; it's a grueling real-world challenge conquered in a country known for its varied altitudes, winding roads, and unpredictable conditions. The implications for everyday drivers are immense: significantly reduced running costs, fewer trips to the pump, and a smaller carbon footprint, all wrapped in the versatile and popular Qashqai SUV package. It showcases how advanced hybrid technology can offer a compelling alternative for those seeking electrification benefits without the range anxiety often associated with pure EVs.

This record-breaking performance strategically positions the Qashqai e-POWER as a formidable contender in the fiercely competitive compact SUV segment. In an era where consumers demand both environmental responsibility and uncompromised utility, Nissan's e-POWER technology offers a unique proposition. It aligns perfectly with Nissan's broader electrification strategy, 'Nissan Ambition 2030', which aims to deliver exciting, electrified vehicles to a wider audience. The Qashqai e-POWER serves as a crucial bridge technology, appealing to drivers who appreciate the immediate responsiveness of electric drive but prefer the familiarity and convenience of gasoline refueling for long journeys.

Beyond the raw numbers, the driving experience of the Qashqai e-POWER is where its true brilliance shines. The seamless transition between power sources, the hushed operation, and the responsive acceleration create a refined and engaging journey. Features like Nissan's 'e-Pedal Step' further enhance efficiency and convenience, allowing for near-one-pedal driving that maximizes regenerative braking and reduces driver fatigue. It’s a testament to Nissan’s vision: to create vehicles that are not only efficient but also genuinely enjoyable to drive, blending cutting-edge technology with practical, everyday usability.

This astounding achievement by the Nissan Qashqai e-POWER is more than just a world record; it's a powerful statement about the future of hybrid powertrains. It proves that with intelligent engineering and a focus on real-world application, hybrid technology can deliver truly revolutionary efficiency, offering a compelling, sustainable, and enjoyable driving solution. As the original pioneer of the crossover segment, the Qashqai continues to innovate, setting new benchmarks and inspiring confidence in Nissan's electrified future. It's an invitation to experience the thrill of electric drive, redefined for the long haul.
